description: In front of you on a red blanket are two small white drawer-like pieces: a taller box unit on the left and a separate small drawer piece on the right. The left hand steadies the taller box while the right hand grasps the small drawer, lifts it up and over, then slides it into the open slot of the taller box and pushes it inward until it seats, leaving the box with both knobs aligned on the front.
